Some sources report that the clash resulted from an attempt by the Gbagyi militia to retaliate the robbery of a local politician by a group of Hausa persons. 3 fatalities split across 2 events coded as 1.

On 17 January 2023, an unidentified armed group shot and killed an inspector of police while patrolling Iheorji Ohanku Road, Aba (Aba South, Abia). The police shot and killed two militiamen and others escaped with gun wounds. The militiamen carted away an AK-47 rifle belonging to the deceased officer. 3 fatalities reported.

On 25 March 2024, police forces engaged a leader of Greenlanders cult militia in an armed clash at the forest in Anambra, coded to Akinima (Ahoada West, Rivers). The militia leader who was declared wanted by the police since 2016 was killed.
On 19 November 2020, Nigerian military troops clashed with a Benue communal militia at Tor Donga (Katsina-Ala LGA, Benue), killing three and injuring others.
On 7 May 2021, Nigerian military troops clashed with a Kaduna communal militia around the Rigachikun (Rigacikun) axis (Igabi LGA, Kaduna), killing one militiaman and one civilian.

On 6 December 2022, police forces repelled a Katsina militia when they blocked a cattle route along Tashar Maje in Kankara LGA (Katsina). Abductees and rustled cattle that were taken away from their village by the militia members [coded separately] were recovered.

On 27 July 2024, the Nigerian police engaged a Benue militia in a firefight, killing six while raiding their enclave in Mbavuur Ward (Logo, Benue). The police recovered an AK-47 rifle and two locally fabricated short guns loaded with ammunition.

On 17 September 2023, a joint task force of security operatives presumed to have comprised of soldiers and policemen engaged a Niger militia in an armed clash in a village near Pan Dongari (Rafi, Niger). 52 militiamen including six informants who lived in the community were killed.

On 10 July 2024, an unidentified armed group shot and killed an OSPAC member in the Igwuruta community (Ikwerre, Rivers). The group was responding to a distress call concerning an abduction case when its members were ambushed, and one got shot and killed.

Around 26 May 2021 (as reported), Nigerian police operatives clashed with a Katsina communal militia at Kafur, Danja, Dutsinma, Safana, Batsari and Funtua Local Government Areas in Katsina State, killing five militiamen and recovered 69 rustled cows. 16 suspects were also arrested. Fatalities split across 6 events.

On 5 December 2022, a Sokoto militia numbering about 90 killed three policemen guarding a market and three civilians when they attacked Yar Bulutu market in Sabon Birni LGA (Sokoto) and shot sporadically. The assailants set one of the policemen's vehicle ablaze and threw the body of one policeman into the fire, several other civilians sustained varying bullet wounds.
Around 15 August 2022 (as reported), an unidentified armed group attacked a police squad, wounded three policemen and stole their rifles along Ozoro/ Kwale (Ndokwa West, Delta).

On 27 August 2024, the Nigerian troops ambushed some fleeing Jimmu Sumoli-led Zamfara militiamen and shot ten dead in Magamin Diddi village in Maradun LGA, coded to Faru Magami (Maradun, Zamfara). The militiamen escaped from a clash with the troops in Matusgi, coded separately.
On 10 May 2021, Nigerian police operatives clashed with suspected kidnappers at Ahor community (Ehor) (Uhunmwode LGA, Edo), killing three and rescuing seven kidnapped victims.

On 20 January 2023, the Nigerian police clashed with an unidentified armed group in Shere (Jos East, Plateau). The armed group abducted the paramount traditional ruler of Izere, Plateau State, and opened fire on the police attempting to rescue the monarch. A civilian guard was shot dead, and a police officer sustained a gun injury during the rescue operation. 1 fatality reported.

On 1 May 2023, a Kaduna militia were engaged in an armed clash with security operatives at Dorayi village in Zaria LGA (Kaduna) where they abducted about 20 persons and rustled cattle. The assailants abandoned the abductees, burnt down one house and two motorcycles before they fled.

On 31 December 2021, police forces, together with member of Igabi communal militia, clashed with Kaduna militia members at the Sabon Birni forest (Igabi, Kaduna) while the group was raiding one of the militia camps. One militiaman was killed, others fled with gunshot wounds; two others were arrested and nine abducted victims were rescued including one who sustained a bullet injury.
On 16 October 2020, the Supreme Vikings cult militias clashed with one another in Ugbomoro community (Uvwie, Delta) coded as Effurun. One person was killed.
On 11 August 2024, the Aye (Black Axe) and the Vikings clashed and killed one person in the Orji area of Owerri (Owerri Municipal, Imo).

On 16 August 2022, Nigerian troops of Operation Forest Sanity clashed with a Kaduna militia when they raided their camps in Manini (Chikun, Kaduna) and Kuriga [coded separately] area. The camps were cleared and six abductees including a baby were rescued, there are no further details.
On 6 July 2020, an unidentified armed group attacked a vehicle while on transit along Okene-Lokoja highway (Okene, Kogi). One presumed policeman was killed, two others were abducted.

On 11 September 2021, police forces of Nigeria engaged IPOB militants in an armed clash in Amaifeke (Orlu, Imo) coded to Amike; three militants were killed, two were arrested and an unspecified number escaped with gunshot wounds.
On 5 July 2022, an unidentified armed group killed a policeman during an attempt to assassinate the deputy governorship candidate of the APC at the GRA axis of Port Harcourt (Port Harcourt, Rivers).

On 12 February 2022, Nigerian police and military forces, together with local vigilantes, engaged Niger militiamen in a clash in Nasko (Magama, Niger), after the militiamen attacked civilians at villages around Nasko (coded separately). Scores of militiamen were killed; 20 abductees were rescued, large herds of cattle, weapons and ammunition were recovered. Scores of fatalities coded as 20.

Around 30 September 2021 (week of), an unidentified cult group killed four suspected members of a rival group in Kuchibena, near the Life Camp, Abuja (Abuja Municipal, FCT). The assailants dismembered the body of one of their victims, chopped off his head and hung it on a stick. The community had been in palpable fear over the incessant cult clashes and killing in the area, prompting the police to request that the slums in the area be demolished. 4 fatalities reported.

Property destruction: On 9 June 2022, Bassa Kwomu militiamen set eight houses ablaze including the palace of the traditional ruler when they invaded Mozum (Bassa, Kogi). The militiamen were suspected to have been hired from Agatu in Benue state, the attack was a reprisal for the murder of a palm wine tapper [coded separately].

On 18 December 2023, an unidentified armed group killed the police orderly of a high court judge, then proceeded to abduct the judge and her driver as they were traveling along Okobo axis of Oron-Uyo road (Oron, Akwa Ibom). The assailants had posed as a local defense militia on the road. The abductees were released on 23 December, there are no reports on ransom payment.

Two abductees were rescued, two members of the group were arrested and others fled. It is not clear if a clash occurred, casualties are unknown.
